top_signals.title: Philippines Eyes New Retail Peso Bond at 25-Year Milestone
top_signals.summary: The Philippines is looking to expand its pool of individual debt investors with a new issuance of Retail Treasury Bonds, according to people familiar with the plan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Soccer superstar Kylian Mbappé on ending 20-year journey with Nike: 'It was time to change'
top_signals.summary: Soccer Champion Kylian Mbappé said he was ready for "change" after ending his association with Nike and entering a deal with Swiss sportswear brand On.
